issues.description: filters='*.exe' breaks the file picker on Linux and macOS where conda has no extension
issues.detail: The browse dialog restricts selection to *.exe, which is a Windows-only convention. On Linux and macOS, conda/mamba/micromamba are extensionless binaries and will be invisible in the picker. Use a platform-aware filter or no filter; the validate_conda callback already enforces correctness.

issues.description: Substring match in validate_conda accepts any binary whose --version output contains 'conda', 'mamba', or 'micromamba'
issues.detail: `any(tool in out.decode().lower() ...)` matches 'mamba' as a substring of 'micromamba' (harmless) but also accepts anything whose version string happens to contain those letters. Worse, the check order is meaningless because substring containment is order-independent. Match on the leading token of the version output instead.

issues.description: out.decode() with no encoding and no errors handling will crash on non-UTF-8 locales
issues.detail: run_program returns bytes; decoding with the platform default can raise UnicodeDecodeError on Windows code pages or odd locales. The bare except below swallows it and returns False, so a perfectly valid conda is silently rejected. Decode with errors='replace' or specify encoding explicitly.

issues.description: conda_path widget is added to layout but only enabled/disabled, never visually grouped with its checkbox state
issues.detail: The checkbox toggles enablement of the path field, but there is no signal wiring to clear `conda_path` when `custom_conda` is unchecked, nor to validate that a non-empty path exists when the checkbox is on. A user can check the box, leave the field empty, save, and silently fall back to the not-found error path. Validate the combination on apply.

issues.description: edit.setFocus() in select_file is an unrelated drive-by change in a feature patch
issues.detail: This is the THREE-PATCHES smell: a focus-behavior tweak to a shared widget helper is bundled with a conda-executable feature. When this regresses focus handling somewhere else in six months, bisect lands on 'add custom conda executable' and the maintainer curses. Split it.

issues.description: Empty-string path silently validates as True; intent is unclear
issues.detail: validate_conda returns True for the empty string so the field doesn't show an error when blank. Fine, but document it in the docstring — right now the docstring says it checks the file exists and is executable, which is the opposite of what happens for ''. A reader has to figure out the special case from code.

review.summary: The feature is the right shape — let users point Spyder at a conda binary when auto-detection fails — and the diff is mostly scoped to that. But validate_conda is sloppy: substring matching, naive decode, no encoding handling. The *.exe filter is Windows-brained and will silently break the picker on Linux/macOS. The widget wiring lets a user enable custom-conda with an empty path and discover the failure only at kernel start. And there's a gratuitous setFocus() change to a shared helper bundled in with a conda feature — classic three-patches-as-one. NEEDS-WORK: tighten the validator, fix the filter, validate the on+empty combination, and split the widget change.
